name: Textile Joins
prompt:
Create ONE finely detailed reusable TEXTILE AND MOUNTING COMPONENT SHEET, title INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001 — CURTAINS, CUSHIONS & RUNNER JOINS. Exactly SIXTEEN isolated components,4x4 grid with crisp readable objects, one main view plus small reverse/contact/top inset of same object. Each cell has full suffix D01–D16 and NAME; full sheet ID is in header. Pale ivory background, no humans, rooms or furniture. Use supplied GEN-24 for ivory/rose fabric, fine gold rose/star embroidery and indigo accents. Each object may have independent illustration scale: tiny brackets must remain tiny objects, not architectural wall fragments. Curved track sections must be coherent metal profiles; textile pieces must look thin, soft and separable. All dimensions W,D,H are PROPOSED. D01/D02 share rail end profile. D12/D13 share runner border width and colour; uninterrupted joining edges have no decorative cap or fringe. Illustration does not establish actual seamless texture continuity. Do not regenerate complete beds, room curtains combined with walls, existing mirrors, whole carpets, chandeliers or tabletops. Footer: Proposed accessories; repeat seams, mesh separation and actual fit require modeling review.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D01 — Straight curtain track. Proposed W,D,H [3, 0.08, 0.08]m. One straight fine GOLD CURTAIN RAIL3m long with slender circular track profile and square repeat ends. Show end cross section and concealed slider groove. No curtains or wall attached. Match D02 bore/profile.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D02 — Curtain track corner. Proposed W,D,H [0.4, 0.4, 0.08]m. One90-degree GOLD CURTAIN RAIL CORNER with two straight exposed socket ends, same profile and slider groove as D01. Top view must show a clean right-angle turn, not tangled ornament.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D03 — Curtain mounting bracket. Proposed W,D,H [0.08, 0.15, 0.15]m. One tiny wall CURTAIN BRACKET, flat rear rose plate with two screw holes and projecting arm ending in an open circular rail cradle. No rail length, wall, arch or lamp attached. Show flat back.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D04 — Curtain ring. Proposed W,D,H [0.08, 0.03, 0.08]m. ONE gold curtain RING with small fabric eyelet at bottom, main diameter0.08m; separate rear view of same ring, not a fused cluster. Reuse duplicates along rail.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D05 — Floral tieback. Proposed W,D,H [0.15, 0.15, 0.35]m. One removable FLORAL TIEBACK, short blush rope loop with small gold rose hook plate. Main view shows whole loop, rear inset shows simple wall hook contact. Not a full curtain.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D06 — Curtain tassel. Proposed W,D,H [0.08, 0.08, 0.25]m. One hanging CURTAIN TASSEL, blush braided loop, small gilt collar and straight soft silk fringe. Tiny accessory with clear attachment eye, no furniture or post.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D07 — Canopy corner cap. Proposed W,D,H [0.12, 0.12, 0.15]m. One small CANOPY CORNER CAP, gold rose/star applique with an L-shaped underside seat and plain mounting back, for fabric valance at a right-angle corner. Not a whole canopy post or existing bed finial.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D08 — Translucent privacy curtain. Proposed W,D,H [2, 0.03, 2.6]m. One WIDE TRANSLUCENT PRIVACY CURTAIN panel2m wide2.6m tall, ivory/blush sheer with header loops, low embroidered hem, gentle vertical folds, no rod or wall. Distinct from narrow0.9m bed canopy drape.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D09 — Rose bed throw. Proposed W,D,H [1.8, 2, 0.03]m. One loose ROSE BED THROW1.8x2m, soft blush silk with indigo/gold rose-star border. Main view broad face visible, small reverse inset. This is a thin loose throw, not mattress, duvet or narrow foot runner.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D10 — Square embroidered cushion. Proposed W,D,H [0.5, 0.5, 0.15]m. One SQUARE ACCENT CUSHION0.5x0.5x0.15m, blush velvet with gold embroidered star and ivory piping. Show rear closure. Not a sleeping pillow pair.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D11 — Round embroidered cushion. Proposed W,D,H [0.45, 0.45, 0.15]m. One ROUND ACCENT CUSHION0.45m diameter0.15m thick, indigo velvet with blush/gold radial embroidery and clear circular silhouette. Show reverse side.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D12 — Stair runner repeat section. Proposed W,D,H [1, 0.8, 0.015]m. One FLAT STAIR RUNNER REPEAT TILE1m wide0.8m long, indigo centre with rose/gold borders only along long sides. Both short joining edges plain and same pattern phase, no tassels/end caps. Show top and thin side; do not paint it onto a staircase.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D13 — Stair runner landing return. Proposed W,D,H [1, 1, 0.015]m. One square STAIR RUNNER LANDING TURN1x1m, textile top with matching indigo/rose/gold border turning90degrees around two OUTER edges. Two adjacent continuation edges remain plain for incoming/outgoing runner strips. Top plus reverse inset; no stairs or complete rug.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D14 — Runner retaining rod. Proposed W,D,H [1, 0.03, 0.03]m. One straight tiny STAIR RUNNER RETAINING ROD1m long with two small matching end sockets. Gold hardware only, no runner or stair attached. Show socket back contact.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D15 — Table runner end. Proposed W,D,H [0.4, 0.6, 0.015]m. One TABLE RUNNER END textile panel0.4x0.6m, indigo/blush with gold star border and fringe at ONE outer short end. Opposite short edge plain for length repeat; main flat face and reverse inset. No table or place setting.

INT-TEXTILE-JOINS-001-D16 — Small decorative tapestry border. Proposed W,D,H [1, 0.02, 0.12]m. One straight thin TAPESTRY BORDER strip1m long0.12m tall, embroidered blush/indigo/gold rose-star repeat, two plain joining ends. This is fabric, not a stone cornice. Show reverse stitch backing and narrow edge.

visual_review_notes: All16 requested textile/hardware types appear separately, including reverse/contact views and curtain-track sections. Pink/ivory cloth, indigo star/rose panels and gold mounts match the existing room vocabulary.

D01/D02 main views include ornament caps on joining ends. Remove caps at repeat joints, retaining them only at exposed ends. Tube, cradle, ring and internal slider dimensions need a shared modeled fit contract.

D12 runner repeat has visible end borders/motif phases that are not proven seamless; D13 shows a framed corner pattern rather than a verified incoming/outgoing path. Adjust boundary motifs and corner cuts before creating repeat textures.
D15 fringe and textile backing are present; D16 is illustrated thin embroidery, not a verified UV strip. Repeatability, cloth flexibility and mounting integrity remain unverified.

proposed_hardware_contract.status: proposed; printed bounding dimensions include ornament, image is not fit proof
